headline: Anthropic slips below its IPO price, SpaceX and Tesla reportedly talk a $3.5tn merger, and Sony signs on to market The Witcher 4.

upcoming.what: F1 Qatar GP, 16:00 Irish time (qualifying Sat 18:00)
Cygnus CRS-25 launch to the ISS on Falcon 9, ~15:47 Irish time
Rayman Legends Retold (PC, PS5, Xbox, Switch 2)
UFC Riyadh: Adesanya vs Magomedov, plus Ian Machado Garry vs Amosov (prelims 15:00, main card 18:00 Irish)
F1 Abu Dhabi GP season finale, 13:00 Irish time

items.headline: Anthropic shares slip below $83 IPO price
items.summary: The debut rally unwound and the stock closed around 6.5% lower at about $81.91, while filings showed the Amodei siblings each sold over $280m of shares to underwriters.

items.headline: SpaceX and Tesla reportedly in all-stock merger talks
items.summary: The FT reports a combination valuing the pair at roughly $3.5tn is being negotiated by special board committees, though directors on both sides have ties to Musk.

items.headline: Microsoft declares 'Code Red' after 24-hour 365 outage
items.summary: Internal memos show Microsoft launching a company-wide push to overhaul how it prevents and handles major outages after a historic day-long Microsoft 365 failure.

items.headline: Hardware: Dell revenue doubles on AI servers
items.summary: Dell's Q3 revenue jumped 103% to about $54.9bn, well ahead of estimates, and it raised its full-year outlook for the third time this year on data-centre demand.

items.headline: OpenAI says GPT-6 can design proteins by reasoning alone
items.summary: OpenAI reports its GPT-6 models produced new protein shapes and sequences using reasoning and code, without calling specialised biology models. Treat as a company claim until independently tested.

items.headline: Ariane 6 launches 36 Amazon Leo satellites
items.summary: Europe's heavy-lift rocket flew another batch for Amazon's broadband constellation, a useful boost for Ariane 6's commercial cadence.

items.headline: Cygnus CRS-25 still pencilled in for Sunday
items.summary: No change reported to Northrop Grumman's cargo run to the ISS on Falcon 9, targeting around 15:47 Irish time on 29 Nov. A quiet news day otherwise.

items.headline: Tonight in Cavan: poor for faint targets, moon-dominated
items.summary: The moon is just past full (around 98% lit) and rises early evening, washing out deep-sky objects; it's dark from about 18:15 after a ~16:20 sunset. The cloud forecast couldn't be retrieved this morning, so check Met Éireann before heading out; the bright moon itself and Jupiter rising in the east later are the best bets if skies clear.

items.headline: Witcher 4: CD Projekt signs PlayStation marketing deal
items.summary: Announced alongside Q3 results, CDPR's new Sony agreements cover Witcher 4 co-marketing and PlayStation Plus. It isn't an exclusive; the game is still expected in 2028 on PC, PS5 and Xbox.

items.headline: CDPR pitches Witcher 4 as a GTA 5-to-6 sized leap
items.summary: On the earnings call the studio framed the generational jump over The Witcher 3 in GTA terms, a bold bar to set.

items.headline: Ciri's temperament will reshape Witcher 4 quests
items.summary: Following yesterday's comments, CDPR says Ciri's emotional reactions will change how quests play out, not just dialogue flavour.

items.headline: Quiet week; No-Gi Worlds 10-12 December
items.summary: No major results since Polaris 40. The IBJJF No-Gi World Championship is the next big date, about two weeks out.

items.headline: No UFC this weekend; Riyadh card on 5 December
items.summary: The UFC is off on 28-29 Nov, with ONE and Cage Warriors among the weekend's other shows. Next up is Adesanya vs Magomedov in Riyadh, where Ireland's Ian Machado Garry faces Yaroslav Amosov; main card around 18:00 Irish.

items.headline: Hamilton denies Ferrari demand amid Leclerc friction
items.summary: Fresh tension inside Ferrari heading into Qatar, with Hamilton rejecting reports he made demands of the team after a run-in with Leclerc.

items.headline: Herta's F1 push falls apart after Cadillac snub
items.summary: Colton Herta's route to an F1 seat collapsed and his reaction drew criticism from pundits as 'childish'.

items.headline: Bearman slams Vegas 'joke' as Haas fights for millions
items.summary: Bearman criticised how the Las Vegas race unfolded for Haas, with the team in a close constructors' scrap worth serious prize money. Qatar is this weekend: race Sunday 16:00 Irish.
